headline: Argentina Enters Technical Recession as Third-Quarter Activity Falls 1.8%
summary: Argentina's economic activity declined by 1.8% in the third quarter, marking the second consecutive quarterly contraction and tipping the country into a technical recession.
why: Economic contractions in Argentina reflect ongoing macroeconomic pressures, declining investor confidence, and high inflation under the current reform program.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Falling GDP growth denotes an economic slowdown and recessionary environment.
